analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($60.39) vs SMA5 ($60.14)/SMA20 ($65.22)/SMA50 ($68.33): Short-term bullish, mid-term bearish diagnosis, above SMA5, below SMA20/50.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($68.66)/SMA200 ($64.81): Maintaining mid-to-long-term bearish trend strength.
· 52-week position (48.7%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (36.6→38.9): Exited oversold, continuing neutral range, lacking direction.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.3035→-0.6428): Diagnosis of worsening, signaling continuation of bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $65.22): Consolidating near the middle band, bandwidth at 22.69% indicates moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($57.54): Based on Pivot S1 and 20-day low.
· Swing Resistance ($68.35): Based on SMA50, potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low recovery initiation): Suggesting potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.54x): Decreased confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Conditions for entry: Consider buying upon confirmation of RSI recovery above 50 and MACD improvement.
